[Section] Acknowledgments
[source_id=80] Katherin Yu, Jan Hula, Patrick Xia, Raghu Pappagari, Shuning Jin, R. Thomas McCoy, Roma Patel, Yinghui Huang, Edouard Grave, Najoung Kim, Thibault Févry, Berlin Chen, Nikita Nangia, Anhad Mohananey, Katharina Kann, Shikha Bordia, Nicolas Patry, David Benton, and Ellie Pavlick have contributed substantial engineering assistance to the project.
[source_id=81] The early development of jiant took at the 2018 Frederick Jelinek Memorial Summer Workshop on Speech and Language Technologies, and was supported by Johns Hopkins University with unrestricted gifts from Amazon, Facebook, Google, Microsoft and Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories.
[source_id=82] Subsequent development was possible in part by a donation to NYU from Eric and Wendy Schmidt made by recommendation of the Schmidt Futures program, by support from Intuit Inc., and by support from Samsung Research under the project Improving Deep Learning using Latent Structure. We gratefully acknowledge the support of NVIDIA Corporation with the donation of a Titan V GPU used at NYU in this work. Alex Wang's work on the project is supported by the National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program under Grant No. DGE 1342536. Any opinions, findings, and conclusions or recommendations expressed in this material are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Science Foundation. Yada Pruksachatkun's work on the project is supported in part by the Moore-Sloan Data Science Environment as part of the NYU Data Science Services initiative. Sam Bowman's work on jiant during Summer 2019 took place in his capacity as a visiting researcher at Google.
